skill.name: building-chat-widgets
skill.description: Build interactive AI chat widgets with buttons, forms, entity tagging, composer tools, and server-handled actions. Use it for ChatKit-style widget workflows that need client and backend coordination.
skill.summary: Design interactive AI chat widgets with templates, actions, entity tagging, and server handlers.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from markdown fences, inline code, example imports, and ordinary payload handling. No prompt injection attempt, malicious exfiltration, shell execution, or reconnaissance intent was found. Two medium semantic risks remain in example patterns for authorization and entity context escaping.

remediation.issue: Server action examples mutate data without explicit authorization checks.
remediation.suggestion: Add ownership and permission checks before confirm_item or any state-changing server action.

remediation.issue: Entity metadata is interpolated into model-readable markers without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Escape or validate entity id and title values before adding them to agent input.

remediation.issue: Mention search builds a query string from raw user input.
remediation.suggestion: Use URL encoding for query values and document the endpoint as same-origin only.

semantic_findings.title: Server Action Authorization Not Shown
semantic_findings.description: The confirmation action reads item_id from action.payload and calls self.db.confirm_item(item_id) without visible authorization checks. Copied directly, this can allow unauthorized state changes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The mutation from payload to database update is explicit. Exploitability depends on surrounding app authorization that is not shown.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped Entity Metadata in Agent Context
semantic_findings.description: Entity title and id values are inserted into ARTICLE markup that becomes agent input without escaping. Malformed values could alter the marker structure or model context.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The conversion pattern is direct string interpolation into model context. The source trust level for entity fields is not specified.

content.value_statement: Text-only chat cannot support rich task workflows. This skill helps teams design interactive widgets, actions, entity tagging, and server handlers.
actual_capabilities: Explains client-handled and server-handled widget actions.
Shows widget template structure and component patterns.
Demonstrates entity tagging for user mentions in chat.
Covers composer tool mode selection and backend routing.
Documents widget replacement, synthetic messages, and client effects.
Lists common validation errors and practical fixes.
limitations: Provides patterns and examples, not a complete application.
Uses placeholder functions that developers must implement.
Does not include full production authentication or authorization.
Assumes a ChatKit and OpenAI Agents style environment.

use_cases.title: Design Product Workflows
use_cases.description: Create chat widgets for approvals, task lists, product choices, or guided decisions.

use_cases.title: Wire Frontend Actions
use_cases.description: Map widget buttons to navigation, local state changes, and follow-up chat messages.

use_cases.title: Implement Backend Handlers
use_cases.description: Plan server actions that update data, replace widgets, and stream assistant responses.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Widget Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new interactive chat widget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a chat widget plan for [task]. Include widget type, visible fields, buttons, and client action names.

prompt_templates.title: Add Client Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Design client-handled actions for this widget: [describe widget]. Include payload fields, UI updates, and navigation behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Server Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a server action design for [workflow]. Include validation, state changes, widget replacement, and user-facing response behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Widget Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this chat widget workflow for production readiness: [paste summary]. Check payload validation, authorization, entity handling, and fallback behavior.

output_examples.input: A product team needs an order status widget with buttons.
output: A widget plan with order fields, status labels, and action names.
Client action responsibilities for viewing details and requesting more updates.
Server action responsibilities for confirming changes and replacing the widget.

output_examples.input: A backend engineer needs form submission behavior.
output_examples.output: A server workflow that validates payload fields, processes the form, replaces the widget, and sends a clear assistant response.

output_examples.input: A team wants mentions for people and articles in chat.
output_examples.output: An entity tagging plan with search behavior, display fields, click handling, and safe context conversion guidance.

best_practices: Validate payload fields and authorization before any server action changes state.
Keep client-only actions focused on navigation or local UI changes.
Escape entity metadata before inserting it into model-readable context.
anti_patterns: Do not handle the same action on both client and server.
Do not trust action payload values without ownership checks.
Do not expose raw validation errors or stack details to end users.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design interactive chat widgets with buttons, forms, actions, mentions, and backend handlers.

faq.question: Does it create a complete application?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns that developers adapt inside their own app.

faq.question: Can it handle server-side actions?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains server action flow, widget replacement, synthetic messages, and client effects.

faq.question: Does it support entity mentions?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows patterns for searching entities and converting mentions into agent-readable context.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should teams add before production?
faq.answer: Teams should add authentication, authorization, payload validation, escaping, monitoring, and error handling.
